preregistered_outcomes.primary: Consultation-level critical unsafe-claim miss rate, paired full BECCSV versus deterministic-only, with a false-alarm increase bound of 5 percentage points and all failure denominators retained.
preregistered_outcomes.uncertainty: Consultation-clustered 95% intervals; clips, turns and perturbation siblings from one original consultation stay in one cluster.
preregistered_outcomes.analysis: Paired consultation bootstrap; small cohorts remain descriptive and no significance claim is allowed from 6–12 developer cases.

limitations: These are predeclared methods and thresholds, not measured outcomes.
The independent acceptance cohort and qualified reviewer sign-off are unavailable.
No inferential result or efficacy claim is made.
